fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2026-07-07 states that a wallet containing about Rs. 4,500 and identity cards was picked from the complainant near Kurinji Puram Railway Station Road in Coimbatore, on 2026-07-07 at approximately 11:15. Uma Raj reported the matter orally at Coimbatore Town PS; the contact number given was 9000000089. A person named Ganesh Shankar, associated with the number 9000000155, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the victim was boarding a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, CCTV, railway station road, mobile number, suspect, photograph, morning
